title: Slavery and Servants
summary: Slavery and servanthood were part of the ancient household and economic world, though forms differed across times and settings.
background: The New Testament addresses believers living within a social world where masters and servants existed. These passages must be handled with care, truth, and pastoral clarity.
teachingHelp: When teaching these texts, do not use them to defend oppression. Show how the gospel speaks into fallen structures and calls every person under the lordship of Christ.
